correctness.rationale: All hypotheses and quantifiers are explicit. Exact variable-step coefficients give a two-step monodromy with trace N/H, determinant xy/H and discriminant s^4 Delta/H^2. A strictly positive backward-Euler projection above the smaller positive eigenslope ensures positivity for both distinct and repeated multiplier cases. Otherwise complex or negative real multipliers force some negative iterate. A difference identity proves strict decrease. Six exact symbolic identities and supplementary rational trajectories replayed successfully from the packaged verifier.

value.rationale: A natural exact infinite-time sign-preservation frontier for a standard adaptive second-order multistep method is determined without a conservative uniform ratio condition; a repeated Floquet root is included. The high-contrast admissible region quantifies an almost twofold mean-step gain and quadratic required contrast, exposing a meaningful distinction from accuracy and perturbation robustness. This is a complete natural two-parameter classification, not an arbitrary finite example.
